common_binary_axis.external_mapping: External team outcome must map unambiguously to the exact economic team represented by the Polymarket p1 outcome.

development_and_confirmation_plan.M1: new-data synchronized acquisition and temporal-resolution feasibility
development_and_confirmation_plan.M2: development-stage mechanism study on new post-M0 data
development_and_confirmation_plan.M3_if_promising: freeze exact candidate statistic, event handling, primary horizon, sample gate, and OOS confirmation rule
development_and_confirmation_plan.M4_if_frozen: new prospective confirmatory OOS collection and one-time readout
development_and_confirmation_plan.execution_stage_if_confirmed: Only after mechanism confirmation: executable bid/ask, latency, spread, fees, slippage, queue assumptions, and conservative fill economics.

explicit_non_decisions: No H5 trading threshold is selected.
No innovation magnitude threshold is selected.
No primary response horizon is selected.
No optimal polling cadence is selected.
No maker/taker execution choice is made.
No winner or settlement data is required.
No F19 trade data is read.
No RN1 wallet behavior is used.
No H2-v2 failed absolute-gap hypothesis is reopened.

external_market_state.consensus_probability: median of all currently valid fresh family probabilities

direct_exchange_source.reason: Direct timestamped updates provide cleaner innovation timing and permit shorter-horizon latency claims.

odds_api_aggregate_source.reason: Historical aggregate-feed refresh cadence is too coarse to assume sub-5-second venue-latency resolution.

horizon_policy.reason: The feasible primary latency horizon depends on source timestamp/update resolution, which must be established without inspecting H5 response.

historical_h2_v2_data_may_be_used_for: identifier-only derivation of the frozen H2-v2 development exclusion set

initial_mechanism_analysis_family.continuous_scale_diagnostic: relationship between external innovation magnitude and subsequent PM p1 midpoint change
initial_mechanism_analysis_family.positive_directional_response_means: Polymarket moved in the same direction as the external innovation
initial_mechanism_analysis_family.reason: M2 is a development-stage mechanism study. Exact candidate statistic and confirmation rule will be frozen only after a separate development stage, before new confirmatory OOS data.

accepted_state_requires: at least two valid fresh exchange families
innovation_definition.new_source_information_requires: At least one contributing exchange family has a source timestamp strictly later than that family's source timestamp in the immediately preceding accepted state.
innovation_definition.primary_event_time: local_receive_timestamp of the first collector observation revealing the new accepted external state
innovation_definition.reason_no_threshold: Initial mechanism testing should not condition on a posthoc magnitude cutoff. All non-zero admissible innovations are retained for development analysis.
innovation_definition.source_timestamp_role: diagnostic and venue-timing evidence; must not replace local receipt time for actionability claims
innovation_definition.unit: one accepted external consensus state change

m0_verdict: NEW HYPOTHESIS FAMILY PREREGISTERED; NO SIGNAL OR ECONOMIC CLAIM

engineering_success_requirements: All markets are outside the frozen F19 registry and outside H2-v2 development evidence.
Exactly two economic outcomes map unambiguously between external venues and Polymarket.
At least two fresh external exchange families are available on >=80% of eligible collection observations.
External source timestamps and local receive timestamps are preserved.
Polymarket valid two-sided p1 top-of-book is available on >=95% of otherwise eligible synchronized observations.
Observed source update cadence and timestamp resolution are measured without calculating PM response.
No in-play state enters the development dataset.
m1_engineering_stage.m1_data_may_enter_m2_development_if: No PM response statistic, H5 signal, directional hit rate, regression, or PnL was inspected before the M1 source/horizon engineering freeze.
m1_engineering_stage.name: H5-M1 temporal-resolution and synchronized-data feasibility
m1_engineering_stage.source_selection_rule: Source architecture for M2 may be chosen only from M1 engineering quality, coverage, temporal resolution, cost, and reliability—not H5 effect size.

name: External Sharp-Market Innovation to Polymarket Repricing
prohibited_before_m2: select innovation threshold from observed response
reuse H2-v2 development effects as H5 evidence
use settlement or winner to select H5 parameters

scientific_position.h5_question: When a fresh external sharp-market consensus changes, does Polymarket subsequently reprice in the same direction?
scientific_position.mechanism: external information innovation precedes Polymarket price adjustment
scientific_position.null: External consensus innovations do not predict subsequent same-direction Polymarket repricing beyond contemporaneous movement/noise.

claim_tiers.actionable_receipt_lead: External state is known locally before subsequent Polymarket move.
claim_tiers.venue_lead: External venue itself moved before Polymarket. This stronger claim is permitted only if M1 demonstrates sufficient source timestamp quality.
